text: Researched existing Claude Code transcript viewers (Claudescope, claude-code-history-viewer, cc_transcript_viewer), Claude Code hooks, OpenTelemetry and ACP, then asked clarifying questions for the BaselHack 2026 yolo-twice project. The answers chose a Node/TypeScript monorepo, hook-triggered ingestion with the session JSONL as source of truth, semantic zoom as the demo focus, redacted raw plus derived data in `.yolo-twice`, and headless `claude -p` for LLM summaries. The output is `documentation/design.md` (247 lines, copied to `~/.claude/plans`) and two memory notes, with two questions still open: the GitHub org for the install line, and how much of the monorepo to scaffold now.
